themes.name: Agentic AI in research
themes.description: Focuses on AI agents that can perform research tasks autonomously or semi-autonomously, including their development, capabilities, and limitations.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Covers AI tools that assist developers in writing, debugging, and optimizing code, as well as the security implications of AI-generated code.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Encompasses various AI-powered tools and platforms designed to aid researchers in data analysis, literature review, and scientific discovery.

themes.name: AI summarization
themes.description: Explores the use of AI to condense large amounts of text, data, or conversations into concise summaries for quicker understanding.

themes.name: Synthetic users
themes.description: Discusses the creation and use of artificial users or data for testing, training, or simulation purposes in AI and product development.

themes.name: AI for product management
themes.description: Highlights how AI tools are being used to support product managers in areas like ideation, feature development, and market analysis.

themes.name: Sentiment & feedback analysis
themes.description: Covers AI applications for analyzing customer feedback, reviews, and social media sentiment to understand user opinions and emotions.

themes.name: AI for design & research
themes.description: Focuses on AI tools and techniques used to enhance the design process, including generative design and AI-assisted ideation.

themes.name: AI survey tools
themes.description: Examines the use of AI in creating, distributing, and analyzing surveys to gather insights from user populations.

themes.name: AI testing automation
themes.description: Discusses how AI is used to automate various testing processes in software development and quality assurance.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
